notes.title: Bubbits Demo Update - Playstyles!
notes.content:
This Update is all about Playstyle and lots more! If you so desire, you are now able to aim with your mouse with the Modern Playstyle (Change in the options)! 
It makes for a more laid back experience because Bubbits can be a bit challenging, especially at the beginning!

Of course we still got our Classic Playstyle as well and both Modes have their own separate Highscores!

This Update in Short:
[list]
[*] Added Modern / Classic Playstyle
[*] Added new Power Up: Snap!
[*] Infinite Bubble Hold switches!
[*] Game Loading twice as fast!
[*] Fire and Hold Prefire window (now feels even smoother to control!)
[*] Bubble landing 300% more smooth
[*] Added King Pings Castle Playfield Background
[*] Added Yuis Retreat Playfield Background
[*] Royale Mode Bubbots Difficulty Nerf
[*] Tons of Adjustments and Bugfixes
[/list]

Until next time, catch you in the Royale Finals!

notes.title: GIGANTIC Bubbits Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hey Bubbiteers! 🎉

We've got some huge news for you! 

An absolutely jam-packed update to the Bubbits demo has just landed! We've been listening to your feedback, tweaking, refining, and adding a bunch of exciting new features to make your Bubbit-bouncing adventures even better. 

Here's what’s new:
[list]
[*] 🥊 [b]Battle Royale Mode[/b] - Matchmake into a game of 25 players all competing for the crown!
[*] 🎮[b]Single Player Mode[/b] - Explore half of the first island, and attempt to reach 3 stars on every level!
[*] 🎨 [b]Customization[/b] - Earn coins to spend on switching up your look in the customization menu, change everything from your character, background, cannon and more! 
[/list]

🚀 [b]TRY IT NOW![/b] 🚀
If you haven’t played the demo yet, now’s the perfect time to jump in! And if you have, why not give it another go and check out all the new content?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3238070/Bubbits_Daily_Challenge_Demo/

Also, those of you who played the Steam Next Fest Demo previously will get 5k Bubbicoins in their inventory to spend on cool cosmetics for returning to play this new demo! 

💬 We’d love to hear from you!
Let us know what you think of the update on the Steam forums or our [url=https://discord.gg/PWwcYM3gYB]Discord[/url]. Your feedback helps us make Bubbits the best it can be!

Thanks for playing, and happy bouncing! 😊
